reviews.title: Decent results, app could use improvement
reviews.contents:
The videos and interactive sessions are good, and it’s nice to see how it guides you through sleep improvement. However the app does have some friction that would be nice to improve. 

It does not pull sleep data from Apple Health, but rather relies on a bespoke integration with Fitbit. If you have any other brand of tracker (Apple, Garmin, Whoop, whatever) you have to manually enter the diary each day. A better experience would be for it to pull sleep data from Apple.

Second is that the app seems to be a wrapper around their web site. If your signal is a bit bad, you just get an error screen. No content, can’t see your diary, nothing. Better offline support would be useful.

reviews.title: A bit buggy…
reviews.contents:
I have been dying this app for three weeks now and have found it to be be a little annoying, in that there are often many delays in loading pages with the circle going round and round. Sometimes it logs me out unexpectedly and I like to stay logged in, but when I try to log in, it doesn’t load, so I have to return hours later. It also told me my sleep had improved during one week, when it had got worse and I had some very bad nights. I’ve decided not to follow the schedule it recommends just yet, as I’m going through a decent period of sleep right now and making the and it would be detrimental to my health if I followed it, though I will attempt the schedule if I start going downhill again. I’ve been entering my times on the diary which show I’m not following the schedule, but the app doesn’t realise this.
I think the tips are good and the videos and I’m sure the schedules work, but the app itself needs refining so it’s less buggy here and there.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.contents: I was despairing about my poor sleep and felt the irregular sleep was affecting my overall health.  I came across this app, available through NHS Highlands.  It has been fantastic.  I enjoyed the well presented background reading and all the support options.  All very accessible, straightforward and never too much all at once.  I progressed through the programme and my sleep has improved beyond my hopes.  I am sleeping better, with more regular times and feel more in charge of myself and my sleep.   I enjoyed and learned from the information, I appreciate the daily tips and I particularly like the sleep diary as it is so easy to complete on the app.  I like the feedback through the weekly review as well.  I recommend this app very highly.  It’s so manageable and doable.  I feel so much better all round! Give it a go and see what you feel:)

reviews.title: Great program, poor app, zero support
reviews.contents:
The program itself is great, and helped me get my sleep back on track, which has been terrible for years. However, having completed the program, I want to keep using the app to track my sleep, to stay on top of it. The app continually asks each week if I want to change my sleep schedule, and there is no option to make it shorter, only longer. I’d like an option to no longer prompt me to change it, once I’ve found a good set of times. I would also like to start over right now, because I had a recent set back, but there’s no option for that either. But the worst thing is that up until about 1 month ago, it remembered my NHS login, now it forgets every day, and insists on a new login. I tried 3 times to contact support, but have had zero response, not even a “Thank you for your email”. Extremely poor. I give the program 5 stars, the app 3, but support 0.

Update: thanks for your response but I work in the NHS and they don’t make me re-authenticate every day, maybe once per month. And your app was working Ok, until it changed to insisting on daily login only recently.

Also, I tried all the email addresses you said, but no responses, automated or otherwise from any of them.
If you can contact me directly or somehow get someone from support to do that, it would be appreciated.

reviews.title: A good app accompanying a good programme
reviews.contents:
Face to face CBT for insomnia is well established as the most effective way of dealing with chronic insomnia. But it’s often expensive and difficult to access.

 Sleepio makes it available on line with a quality programme that doesn’t cut any corners. This accompanying app is very much fit for purpose. 

 I’m on my fourth week with Sleepio on the recommendation of my doctor. And I’m really getting to grips with my insomnia after years of totally chaotic sleep. (You don’t need a doctor’s referral though) 

 A sleep diary is at the heart of the programme.  This app makes it very straight forward to fill in.    I’ve also developed (as part of the programme) a personal schedule that will help me improve my chances of sleeping through the night. That’s available too on the app and so is always at my finger tips. 

 In addition there are a whole range of resources to help with the racing mind and the anxiety that so often goes with insomnia. I’m impressed. 

The programme requires commitment and a willingness to let go of old and less good habits. We insomniacs need all the help we can get on our journey. This app helps us on our way. And for me? Well, I’m beginning to get results!

reviews.title: Infuriating
reviews.contents: Watching videos on the app is borderline rage inducing, you cannot rewind, you cannot fast forward and you cannot restart so if you miss something that appears fleetingly on the screen such as the recap page you have to watch the entire video to the end and then rewatch everything prior to the point to see one page of information. I also don’t understand how it evaluates how well you are achieving your sleep goals? For the first 2 weeks nothing about my sleep patterns changed but the app kept telling me I had achieved the goal of having a more structured sleep pattern. Finally I have watched 2 videos so far and am trying to watch the third but the constant mentions of things I have been told before which have not previously been mentioned is also making me want to delete the app and give up. Needs a lot of work!

reviews.title: Helpful and user friendly
reviews.contents:
I have found Sleepio App is helpful to steer sleep issues in a more positive direction. In particular it’s helped me with challenging negative thoughts and feelings about my sleep. It’s easy to keep the sleep diary due to simple format in app. 

I look forward to the weekly sessions, hearing feedback on my progress and while there are some obvious factors (like bedroom environment), surprising science backed ideas and techniques that are not so known.  

I would like option to have the session available the same day/time each week, but if you access it a bit later, eg Tues pm, the app doesn’t give you that option to access before Tues am the following week. I would also prefer if there was a short mid-week check in with assessment, reminders and encouragement. 

Recommend employers to support their staff with this app and will help mindset and productivity, as many people have sleep issues either in short or long term. My sleep hours and efficiency have objectively increased in just a few weeks of use, even though I have some physical health reasons for poor sleep.

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.contents: This app has dramatically changed my life. I can’t stress enough how grateful I am to have come across it. I know go to bed at 11 and wake naturally at 6.45 feeling rested. I started the course with a sleep score of 1/10 and a sleep efficiency score of 29% - I was depressed and highly anxious, getting sick a lot. Now I feel so much calmer and feel sleepy and good getting into my bed, which I have made into a kind of cocoon space only for sleep. With this app you will get out what you put in folks but there is hope for you! I suffered with insomnia for about 4 years then found this. THANK YOU SLEEPIO

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.contents: I decided to do this app before recommending it to clients. I’m not a fan of self help apps but this one is different. It’s educational, interactive, and most of all it works. I thought I was an expert on sleep hygiene but it appears not. I’ve learned lots of new techniques and this app is really improving my sleep. You have to put some work into completing diaries and sessions but you have to put effort into anything worth while. This is the only app I recommend and I recommend it highly.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.contents: Honestly it’s not that great an app and I don’t see how it’s supposed to help me sleep, it’s videos of information why sleep is good for you and it’s information I’m already aware of, you cannot change the voice for the ‘sleep now’ section and the man’s voice is very sharp and loud not easy to sleep to, there’s also no option for when you haven’t slept overnight and no matter what I input it’s saying my sleep was 100% when I didn’t sleep. This is very different from the CBT I did in person years ago and honestly not helpful at all, everyone is different so this won’t help everyone with insomnia esp those of us with life long insomnia and it’s infuriating that I have to use this useless app rather than get proper help from the NHS
